title: Programmatic Fatal Crash Rapid Response Program / Fatal Traffic Crashes / Identification and Implementation / Near and Long Term Safety Improvements
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that Council INSTRUCT the Los Angeles Depmiment of Transportation, in consultation with the Los Angeles Police Department, to report on the feasibility and resources necessary, including the creation of a dedicated funding source or budget allocation, to establish a Programmatic Fatal Crash Rapid Response Program following serious and fatal traffic crashes, similar to the Cities of Seattle and Atlanta, that would include an expedited engineering and field review of the location and the identification and implementation for near-and long term safety improvements. PRESENTED BY: - - - - -- - - - - - - MARQUEE CE HARRIS-DAWSON HEATHER HUTT Councilmember, 8th District Councilmember, 10 th District flty OCT o 7 2026
